vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope vBRIEF for the bedtime routine flow

narratives.Overview: Implement the forward-only bedtime routine for one otter kid at a time: feeding, dressing, brushing teeth, Otter Flop play with dad, visual prayer moment, instrumental lullaby, and final tuck-in.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: Each otter kid follows the same ordered bedtime flow with no child-facing branching. FR-2: A kid is marked complete only after all routine steps are finished. FR-3: The game supports caring for multiple unlocked otter kids one at a time in sequence. FR-4: Completion progress is clearly visible without requiring much reading. NFR-1: The flow must be calm, short-step, and easy for a preschooler to understand. NFR-2: The UI should rely mostly on icons, animation, and scene cues instead of text-heavy instructions.
narratives.Traces: Implements FR-1 through FR-4 and NFR-1 through NFR-2.
